name: Box2D
vendoredManifestCommand: cd Sources/CBox2D && find include/box2d src LICENSE -type f | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256
compiledManifestCommand: cd Sources/CBox2D && find include/box2d src LICENSE -type f \( -name '*.c' -o -name '*.h' -o -name LICENSE \) | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256
compiledSources: src/*.c: exactly upstream's BOX2D_SOURCE_FILES (src/CMakeLists.txt); public headers exactly BOX2D_API_FILES

buildSettings.target: CBox2D (never a product; apps use LabKitRigid, which has `internal import CBox2D`)
buildSettings.cLanguageStandard: c17 (upstream: C_STANDARD 17, C_EXTENSIONS YES; both gnu17 and c17 compile warning-free)

defines.NDEBUG: release only (SwiftPM never defines it; without it B2_ASSERT stays on)

buildSettings.simd: NEON on arm64 (device and arm64 simulator), SSE2 on x86_64 simulator; chosen by src/core.h, no flags
buildSettings.lengthUnitsPerMeter: 0.1, set once per process by LabKitRigid (RigidUnits) before the first world

verification.gitCheckout: diff -r against a clone of tag v3.1.1 (HEAD 8c661469, tree f411f519): src, include/box2d and LICENSE identical
verification.archive: diff -r against the extracted GitHub tarball (SHA-256 above; git get-tar-commit-id = commit): identical
verification.sourceList: src/*.c + src/*.h (57 files) == BOX2D_SOURCE_FILES in upstream src/CMakeLists.txt
